analysis: The supplied units cover only CHANGELOG.md head text (lines 1-236 and 237 onward). This is documentation only, so no runtime code changed. Because it is a changelog, I cannot confirm that the described behavior matches the real implementation; the source files behind these entries were not supplied, so that remains a coverage limit. The entries describe security-relevant behavior that matches the existing threat model: the frozen legacy MDM cohort, which fits TB-009 and TB-011 and T-052 to T-058; the /v1/enroll proof requirement; App Attest protocol 3 only; the attestation challenge fail-closed change; removal of the unauthenticated earnings lookup, which is T-031; and the MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION floor. One note: the changelog says the production environment reference file prod.env was changed to 0.9.5 while the live value must be raised by a human. That is an operational caveat rather than a regression. The changelog also cites the SEC-035 re-acceptance for the SSD TTL going from 15 to 30 minutes. That relates to T-041, whose definition was oversized and not supplied here, so the next pass should check it against the code. Cross-file interactions for later passes: coordinator/internal/provider/legacymdm/policy.go, coordinator/appattest/authorization.go, the final-handoff check in coordinator/registry/inference_authorization.go, and the enroll handler. No new attack surface or invalidated assumptions are evident from the text alone.
